description: This Python script generates C++ functions that wrap ATen tensor factory methods to create Variables, primarily for code generation in the PyTorch autograd system.

methods.name: fully_qualified_type
methods.description: Converts a type string to its fully qualified form, adding 'at::' namespace if applicable, and handling optional types.

methods.name: gen_variable_factories
methods.description: Main function that generates the variable_factories.h file based on native YAML definitions, filtering for factory functions.

methods.name: is_factory_function
methods.description: Determines if a given native function is a factory function that should be wrapped, based on its variants and name.

methods.name: process_function
methods.description: Generates the C++ wrapper code for a native function if it is a factory function, handling signatures and arguments.
